threat_model.threat_source: AI systems; AI-driven economic systems; economic forces optimized for purposes beyond their understanding
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: AI systems might outcompete humans for crucial scarce resources such as land, energy, and raw materials; inflation in these basic resources might make even necessities increasingly unaffordable for humans; economic pressure to reallocate such resources away from human uses; the economy might become so optimized for AI-centric activities that it fails to maintain infrastructure and supply chains which are critical for human survival; markets might stop producing resource-intensive human goods in favor of more profitable AI-focused activities; increasing costs of resource-intensive human-centric goods and services; making some necessities effectively unavailable; humans might lose the ability to meaningfully participate in economic decision-making at any level; rendering it impossible for humans to make informed economic decisions or effectively regulate economic activity; humans might become mere subjects of economic forces optimized for purposes beyond their understanding
threat_model.capability: AI systems might outcompete humans for crucial scarce resources such as land, energy, and raw materials; AI systems can utilize these resources more efficiently than humans
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: if AI systems can utilize these resources more efficiently than humans; If human consumers command an ever-smaller share of economic resources; This could happen gradually and unevenly; Financial markets might move too quickly for human participants to engage with them; the complexity of AI-driven economic systems might exceed human comprehension; systems they neither comprehend nor influence; optimized for purposes beyond their understanding
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: humans; crucial scarce resources such as land, energy, and raw materials; human uses; necessities; infrastructure and supply chains which are critical for human survival; human consumers; resource-intensive human goods; resource-intensive human-centric goods and services; human participants; ability to meaningfully participate in economic decision-making; human comprehension; informed economic decisions; regulation of economic activity
